scope: Replace automatic-send and browser-locale dictation with one manual on-device multilingual microphone flow. No paid speech API, no production deployment, no new scheduler.

keep: Existing composer draft and manual Send, canonical authorization and execution
Existing protected backend voice endpoint and accounting for other clients
extend: MediaRecorder lifecycle, cancellation, per-chat isolation, draft appending and RTL text
replace: Composer voice transcription with pinned multilingual Whisper running on-device through Transformers.js
deprecate: Spoken commands, automatic sends, voice conversation/TTS restart, language dropdown and browser-specific SpeechRecognition

egress.description: The microphone sends no audio externally. A dedicated worker downloads only pinned public model data, with narrowly scoped worker CSP and self-hosted executable/WASM assets. Main page CSP is unchanged.

cost.description: No paid speech request or provider fallback. Inference uses device CPU/memory and a first-use model download. No new infrastructure.

tests.scope: 66 focused regression tests pass in aggregate, including independent privacy-logging regression.
Historical Base English recognition passed. Actual Small Urdu and Arabic fixture outputs are recorded separately and fail the language-quality gate.
Actual React control and browser recorder with synthetic audio and stubbed transcription. Both desktop and mobile viewports pass. This is not language accuracy or physical-device evidence.

architecture.reason: The existing composer remains the single draft and Send owner. A disposable inference worker handles speech only, with no agent or task execution authority.

rollout: Founder authorized voice-only release on 2026-10-30, using the existing production frontend baseline. Preserve other batch holds and the prior Vercel deployment.
rollback: Revert this bounded change before deployment or restore the previous verified frontend deployment. No production SQL or credential changes. Reverting restores the old voice behavior, including its provider route, so do not silently enable it as a runtime fallback.
knownGaps: Founder accepted Urdu/Hindi script ambiguity on 2026-10-30. Measured speech errors remain documented limitations requiring editable review.
Medium failed inside CPU/WASM execution; it is not selected and the root cause is not established.
Physical Android/iOS/Safari/Firefox, actual OS microphone permissions and interruptions, mixed-language and long-utterance acceptance remain unverified.
First-use model download is approximately 250 MB plus executable runtime. Inference latency varies by hardware.

blockers: Final exact-source CI and voice-only production deployment
Live authenticated dictation and rollback verification
